independent_cone: First always @* computes CURRENT validation, error/busy/offers and base progress/reservation. No readiness read.
retirement_cone: Second always @* consumes validated offers/readiness and base plan; only external context_next/context_we outputs, never writes validation outputs. No raw control state.
preack_peer_validation: same restored legality/currentclean checks as predecessor before offers; no error introduced upon ready
equivalence_reasoning: Existing trusted valid contexts own reservations from old input before any retirement. Allocation predicate uses old trusted&&!valid, not next state.
Every ack clears a trusted valid FIX3 engine; that engine cannot allocate on same edge.
Every restored peer has a CE contextword and is untrusted; neither progression nor allocation can write that peer.
Two scrub targets in one context would violate required other2 CURRENTclean and fail closed before any offers; repeated target reservation also fails closed.
Therefore moving actual ack updates after independent base allocation/progression preserves write order/value; ack target sets do not conflict with allocation.
Error conditions formerly repeated inside ack already validated before offers; removing repeated checks leaves error independent of readiness.
